message.content: The U.S. Declaration of Independence was officially adopted on **July 4, 1776**, but the actual signing of the document by most of the Continental Congress delegates took place on **August 2, 1776**. (A few signatures were added later, and the original draft was signed on July 4, but the formal signing ceremony occurred on August 2.)
